title: 401 — no access_token cookie on a protected balance read
description: The discovery endpoints of mock-amm-hp-01 to -05 need no credentials; everything that touches a bank's own position does. The cookie-auth middleware rejects this before the handler runs.
notes: Verified in the delivered Scenario B gateway middleware (internal/http/middleware/auth.go), byte-identical to Scenario A's. Bearer auth is accepted on twelve /api/v2 routes but NOT here and NOT on the swap endpoints. No CSRF header exists anywhere on the platform; SameSite=Strict is the only cross-site mitigation, and that absence is recorded as a finding rather than papered over.
